title: 有馬記念の後に・憧れを超えて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All three are evenly matched. All of them are worthy of representing a generation of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Which means this will come down to one thing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now, Kita! Now!

text_block_list.name: Groove and Brusque
text_block_list.text: Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: GOOO, KITASAN! You can do this! You can win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's Kitasan Black! Kitasan Black has passed the finish line first and won!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She's claimed the most astounding victory on the final stage of the year! Three cheers for our star! She's won it for us regular folks!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I… won?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I won. I won! I WON! Finally… I ran my first serious race against Dia…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: But that's not all… I also beat Teio! I really did it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I WOOON!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita… I lost…
choice_data_list: That was a great race, Dia.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh… Thank you, but…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I… I meant to close the gap between us. That's what I was supposed to do!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So why… why did you feel so far ahead?
choice_data_list: Maybe… it's how many people's dreams are pushing Kitasan Black on.
Maybe… it's how many people's dreams are pushing Kitasan Black on.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Dreams?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Now that you mention it, I remember hearing a lot of cheering for Kita during the race…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Particularly from those who shouted with every fiber of their being…
choice_data_list: Those were the fans who have supported her every step of the way.
Those were the fans who have supported her every step of the way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All Umamusume get stronger by running alongside their rivals. In Kitasan Black's case, however…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She not only had rivals staying astride with her, but fans who adored her from the very beginning too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If enough of them gather together, even the faintest glow in the night can become a roaring bonfire of support.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer… Thank you… so much…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I… I—
choice_data_list: Take a look at the stands.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The stands? Oh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There she sees…

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Kitasan Black! Thank you, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You were amazing! You're the best… You're simply the best!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh… Oh my gosh… Everyone's smiling… They're all so happy!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I did it… I finally did it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All those wishes gave her the strength to run, and to aim for her own dream beyond this victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sheer scale of her earnest desire to see the fans smile is what made Kitasan Black win.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Kita, you're a Triple Crown champion through and through.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Teio…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It's been forever since I've felt this frustrated, but…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm actually glad there's another Umamusume who can get me this riled up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It feels even more satisfying that it's you, since you've been chasing after me for so long. I think I understand how Prez feels now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-you're flattering me! Getting to run with you after looking up to you since forever ago was like a real dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, I'd better keep getting stronger so I will always be someone you look up to! All right. I'll see you later, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …Kita.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dia.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Can you… pinkie swear with me again?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Promise that this won't be the last time we race. I still want to chase you down, Kita.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Of course, Dia! I still want to run so many more races with you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They exchange an eternal promise. Then, Kitasan Black turns back to the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming out today, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Did you have fun?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Glad to hear it! It was a long time coming, but…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I was finally able to run a race that made you all smile.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: This is what festivals are all about! This is what I've been wanting to do! But…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Now that I've finally accomplished my goal, I know what I want to do next.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: This isn't the end. As long as I set my mind to it, I can throw an even bigger festival! But you know what?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I can't do it alone. I need even more fans to cheer me on and support me through everything!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So I'm going to put my next plan into motion from today onward, but not just as Kita the clutch captain or Kita the festival guru.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm going to keep trying to catch up with my upperclassmen, guiding my younger peers toward success and bringing everyone together!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm going to create an even more grandiose stage for everyone. But to do that, I've got to get lots and lots stronger!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Strong enough to carry the Twinkle Series through a big, big parade!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Will you come with me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yeeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Will you help me, the festival guru, get everyone hyped up?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yeeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even the way she fires up a crowd is refreshing. This race might just have been the thing that helped Kitasan Black truly come into her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whether she's the clutch captain or the festival guru, Kitasan Black is a true leader who's there to lead even the most experienced Umamusume forward.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: After this will be our concert! Don't worry! I'll sing all my songs to the very end, just like how I run all my races to the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: C'mon, everyone! Let's put our hearts and souls into this alongside our dear friends!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's winning concert time! Let's take it up to eleven!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Boom, boom!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The joyful cheers that follow shake the ground. It's as if the cheers celebrating the festival of the people since ancient times never stopped.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And standing amidst all the countless smiles is Kitasan Black, now the most beloved Umamusume in everyone's heart.
